messages:
sam: quick q — I'm about to merge a change to the chooser that changes how `model_hint` interacts with `region` and `model_pin`. behavior we want: if `model_pin` present -> always serve pinned model; else if `region` present -> prefer region-compatible variant; else fall back to global default. Does that sound right for API contract? Also, will `served_model` metadata still include `served_model_reason`? cc @maya @liam

maya: I think that's correct. Historically pin > hint > default. The new change flips hint order with region, so we need a compatibility note. Shouldn't break clients if we keep `served_model` field stable. :+1:

liam: small nit — add test for mixed params: `model_pin=redwood-3b`, `model_hint=redwood-3b-quant`, `region=eu` — ensure pinned wins even if region incompatible. I can add a unit test in chooser_test.

ana: CR ping @maya — can you review selector change? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821

maya: on it, will check today. Also, let's add a smoke e2e that verifies `served_model` contains `variant` and `fallback_chain` fields. Example response snippet we expect:
```
{"served_model": "redwood-3b-quant-eu", "served_model_reason": "hint+region", "fallback_chain": ["redwood-3b-quant-eu", "redwood-3b-quant", "redwood-3b"]}
```

sam: perfect. one more: will this change affect routing-cost heuristics? i.e., will eu-hint selection pick higher-cost eu variant automatically? if so we should surface that in rollout notes.

liam: yes it may. I've added a flag `prefer_region_hint` so we can opt-in on canary. plan: deploy canary to internal orgs for 48h.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started for org: internal-team on cluster eu-west-1 (id: canary-2026-03-17-01) :rocket:

maya: thanks — if tests pass i'll merge and we can flip flag for canary.

ana: FYI I'll add a line to API docs clarifying precedence: `model_pin` > `model_id` > (`region`+`model_hint`) > default. will include example queries and expected `served_model`.

sam: thanks all. marking as done for now, will follow up with rollout notes. :eyes:
